phase_prompt.summary: Initial discovery of the chamber, with subtle engine hum and glyphs flickering to life.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A vast subterranean chamber carved into basalt, its walls etched with luminous hieratic glyphs pulsing softly. Towering obelisks of obsidian and polished copper rise from the floor, each topped with a crystalline core refracting light into a spectrum of bio‑luminescent colors. In the center, a massive rune‑carved brass engine whirrs softly, its gears turning in perfect harmony with the rhythmic glow of the glyphs. The air shimmers with a faint metallic mist, and the hum of the engine echoes through the chamber, creating a palpable sense of reverence and awe. Rendered in hyper‑realistic detail, textures feel tactile: rough basalt, slick copper, cool translucent crystals, subtle play of light on carved glyphs.
